sections.shortTitle: Local Authorities Pensions And Gratuities Act 1919
sections.description:
Short title and extent

THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES PENSIONS AND
THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES PENSIONS AND
GRATUITIES ACT, 1919.
(For
Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gazette of India, 1919, Pt. V, p. 18 ;
and for Proceedings in Council, see ibid., 1919, Pt. VI, pp. 144, 145 and 197.)
ACT No. I OF 1919
[26th
February, 1919]
An Act to extend the powers of local authorities in
regard to the granting of pensions and gratuities.
WHEREAS it is
expedient to extend the powers of local authorities in regard to the granting
of pensions and gratuities;
It is hereby enacted
as follows :‑
1.‑ Short title and extent (1) This Act
may be called the Local Authorities Pen sions and Gratuities Act, 1919.
(Subs. by the Central Laws (Statute Reform) Ordinance, 1960
(21 of 1960), s. 3 and 2nd Sch. (with effect from the 14th October, 1955), for
the original sub‑section (2) as amended by A. O., 1949, Arts. 3 (2) and
4.)[(2) It extends to the whole of Pakistan.]

sections.shortTitle: Local Authorities Pensions And Gratuities Act 1919
sections.description:
Power to grant extraordinary pensions and gratuities

THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES PENSIONS AND
THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES PENSIONS AND
GRATUITIES ACT, 1919.
(For
Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gazette of India, 1919, Pt. V, p. 18 ;
and for Proceedings in Council, see ibid., 1919, Pt. VI, pp. 144, 145 and 197.)
ACT No. I OF 1919
[26th
February, 1919]
An Act to extend the powers of local authorities in
regard to the granting of pensions and gratuities.
WHEREAS it is
expedient to extend the powers of local authorities in regard to the granting
of pensions and gratuities;
It is hereby enacted
as follows :‑
3. Power to grant extraordinary pensions and
gratuities-- Notwithstanding anything contained in
any enactment or in any vale made thereunder regulating the powers of local
authorities, and without prejudice to any powers conferred by or under any such
enactment, a local authority may grant a pension or gratuity to any officer
thereof who may, since the 4th day of August, 1914, have been wounded or
otherwise incapacitated n (The original words "the
service of Government" were first subs. by A. O., 1937 and then amended by
A. O., 1961, Art. 2 and Sch. (with effect from the 23rd March, 1956), to read
as above.)[service of the State], and to the widow or child of any such
officer who may have died in consequence of injuries received or illness
contracted since the 4th day of August, 1914, in the course of such service.

Provision as to pensions and gratuities

THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES PENSIONS AND
THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES PENSIONS AND
GRATUITIES ACT, 1919.
(For
Statement of Objects and Reasons, see Gazette of India, 1919, Pt. V, p. 18 ;
and for Proceedings in Council, see ibid., 1919, Pt. VI, pp. 144, 145 and 197.)
ACT No. I OF 1919
[26th
February, 1919]
An Act to extend the powers of local authorities in
regard to the granting of pensions and gratuities.
WHEREAS it is
expedient to extend the powers of local authorities in regard to the granting
of pensions and gratuities;
It is hereby enacted
as follows :‑
4. Provision as to pensions and gratuities‑--(1) Such pension or gratuity may be granted in addition to any
pension or gratuity payable to the officer or his wife or child, as the case
may be, under any general or special orders of (The
original words "His Majesty in Council or of" omitted by A. O., 1961,
Art. 2 and Sch. (with effect from the 23rd March, 1956).)* * * (Subs. by A. O., 1937, for "the G G. in C. ".)[the
(Subs. by F.A.O., 1975, Art. 2 and Table for Central
Government )[Federal Government] or any Provincial Government], but
shall not, save with the sanction of the (Subs. ibid.,
for "L. G." which had been subs. by the Devolution Act, 1920 (33 of
1920), s. 2 and Sch. I, for "G G. in C ".)[appropriate
Government], exceed the amount of the pension or gratuity to which the officer
or his wife or child would have been entitled under any such orders if his
employment by the local authority had been service for the same time and on the
same pay (Subs. by A. O , 1961, Art. 2 and Sch. (with
effect from the 23rd March, 1955), for "under the Crown" which had
been Subs by A. O., 1937, for "under Government".)[ of the
State].
(2) Any pension
granted under this Act may be made to take effect from such date subsequent to
the 4th day of August, 1914, and subject to such conditions as the local
authority may think fit.

ACT No. I OF 1919
[26th

An Act to extend the powers of local authorities in
regard to the granting of pensions and gratuities.
WHEREAS it is
expedient to extend the powers of local authorities in regard to the granting
of pensions and gratuities;
It is hereby enacted
as follows :‑
5. Procedure Subject to the provisions of
this Act, the decision of a local authority to grant a pension or gratuity
thereunder shall be made in such manner and shall be subject to such sanction
as may be prescribed by any enactment or rule regulating the grant by such
local authority of pensions and gratuities:
Provided that in
every case the sanction of the (Subs. by A. O., 1937,
for "L. G.".)[appropriate Government] shall be necessary.
